text.description: Hike to Farewell Gap, then climb the talus slope on the west side of the gap to the summit. Easy class 2 and commonly done as a day trip.

text.description: Trail up McCullough Gulch then a talus ridge; parking is restricted at this trailhead.
Long grassy and talus ridge in the Sangre de Cristo Range accessed from the Lily Lake road.
Rocky ridge scramble that is usually combined with French Mountain and Frasco Benchmark.
Trail to Cathedral Lake, then a loose gully and ridge scramble to the summit above Aspen; rockfall and late-season loose scree are the main concerns.
Gentle slopes above the Mosquito Range, usually done on its own or with neighboring McNamee and Traver.

text.overview: The normal route on the Needle, wandering over the complicated south face. The Needle is a touch gentler than neighboring Crestone Peak, though it remains among Colorado's tougher fourteeners.

text.approach: A talus cone sits beneath the wall by the upper lake; scale it via grass on its left flank or rock on its right flank. Three or more separate starts are spread out above the second-highest lake, so decide which you want ahead of time. Expect about 2.5 hours from the upper trailhead to the first pitch.

text.overview: Depending on the year, possibly the gentlest, most secure line up the peak: tidy scrambling plus moderate snow in place of the northwest gully's ice and rubble. A lengthy couloir facing south leads to the red notch between the twin summits, and reaching its base takes more walking and route-finding.

text.description: Long ridge hike at the southern end of the Sawatch, started from the Baldwin Creek area.
Talus ridge in the Tenmile Range; often joined with Pacific and Atlantic peaks.
Short climb from a high trailhead above Leadville.
Moderate hike from the Clohesy Lake area above Winfield with a talus finish.
Short tundra and talus climb from the Blue Lakes road, often paired with Drift Peak by a Class 3 traverse.
Grassy ridge and flank above the Halfmoon drainage; often linked in a day with Frasco Benchmark and Casco Peak.
Climb through steep gullies on the south face above Geneva Lake; snow can linger in the gullies.
Remote peak near the Continental Divide whose mileage depends on how far a high-clearance vehicle can drive; rough ridge scrambling near the top.
